title: WebGPU Bloom in Rust: Separable Gaussian Blur with wgpu
description: Build a WebGPU bloom effect in Rust with a 256×256 glow pass, two 9-tap Gaussian blurs, and additive compositing over a Phong-lit UFO.
imageAlt: A WebGPU-rendered retro UFO with cyan windows, yellow trim, and a bright blurred tractor beam against a black background.
